task.title: Board columns should grow to fit wider screens
task.description:
We removed the default Blocked column, but now the column width breakpoints don't work as well on wider screens.
It looks to me like the columns are fixed to their minimum width until the viewport reaches about 1640px at which point they start growing. However, with only 5 standard columns, their minimum width only takes up about 1370px. So they need to start growing to fill the available viewport sooner, up to a maximum width.
Also, because we can customize status columns now, not every team will have the same number of columns in their viewport. Ideally, the column width growing/shrinking is based on a factor of viewport/#columns, still with the same min and max column width for all users regardless of column number.
